title: Failed-tool-call to entity mapping and recording policy
detail: Grounds the failed-tool-call to entity mapping policy against real .session/sessions/* transcripts (115 failed tool.execution_result events out of 5031, across 61 sessions). Typed FailedToolCallMapping::{Entity, Unmapped} with explicit UnmappedReason variants (UnknownTool, NoEntityIdArgument, AmbiguousMultipleCandidates, NoSupportedEntityStore). Adds an event-based mine_failed_tool_call_signals miner (the turn-based one never fires on real data: 0 of 2670 captured turns across 61 sessions have role=tool).
